storage: Airtight container away from light and heat; colour fades with time, so use within about 6 months once opened.
looksLike: a bright, deep red powder with mild heat, used to colour gravies red without making them very hot.
howToPick: a vivid, even red; a dull brown or very bright artificial red suggests added colour or age.
shelfLife: about 6 to 12 months sealed (general guidance; not from a source in this run).
substitutes: Regular red chilli powder plus a little paprika
